scope: Durable ordered mock application phase trace, failure-step persistence, and safe failure diagnostics.

test_environment.database: isolated temporary SQLite, reopened between persistence assertions

red_observations.result: EXPECTED_FAILURE: both new tests showed missing per-phase completion/failure statuses, missing required phases, and no durable failing-phase attribution.
EXPECTED_FAILURE: FILL_LOCATION, ANSWER_STANDARD, and ANSWER_CUSTOM sanitized to UNKNOWN; contact failure metadata reported last completed UPLOAD_RESUME instead of active FILL_CONTACT.

validations.summary: 36 tests ran; 30 passed; 6 UI browser tests skipped because this worktree has no apps/web/dist/index.html.
2 trace tests passed, including all ten phases, status order, API readback after reopening SQLite, a persisted FAILED contact phase, and no answer/contact-value echo.
New fixed-phase allowlist checks and mock browser failure-step capture passed.

root_cause_and_fix.root_cause: handle_browser_failure used only the last completed application transition for diagnostic current_step and ignored active_step, so a failure during contact filling was mislabeled as the earlier completed upload phase.
root_cause_and_fix.fix: Failure diagnostics now use the active fixed phase, falling back to the last completed transition or UNKNOWN. The debug sanitizer allowlists the fixed FILL_LOCATION, ANSWER_STANDARD, and ANSWER_CUSTOM phase labels.
root_cause_and_fix.preserved_privacy: Attempt traces contain only fixed phase labels/statuses. Existing serialized and screenshot privacy canaries passed; answer values, form content, and exception text remain excluded.
root_cause_and_fix.mock_submission_boundary: One success path submitted only to the in-process MOCK fixture and verified its single local receipt. The interruption path produced no receipt. No real ATS, external submission, or external browser request was used.

not_run_or_limited.ui_browser_acceptance: SKIPPED: six tests require apps/web/dist/index.html; this isolated worktree has no apps/web/node_modules, installed Vite, or built dist artifact.
not_run_or_limited.web_build: NOT_RUN: required web dependencies and build output are absent; no install was attempted.

root_verification.summary: 36 tests ran, 30 passed, and 6 were skipped because the UI browser suite requires a web build.
